word.definition: Volition is a formal word that means “the power to make your own choices or decisions.” Usually, though not always, volition follows own , as in “left the company of her own volition.”

sports_fact.text: On September 20, 1973, Billie Jean King beat Bobby Riggs in the 'Battle of the Sexes' before 30,000 at the Astrodome and a TV audience of 90 million.

market.headline: Stock Market News, Sept. 18, 2026: Tech Stocks Climb as Treasury Yields Rise
market.summary: The 2-year Treasury yield moved to its highest level in two years in anticipation of more Fed rate hikes.

quote.text: When the first savage saw his hut destroyed by a bolt of lightning, he fell down upon his face in terror. He had no conception of natural forces, of laws of electricity; he saw this event as the act of an individual intelligence. … The story of the hero who slays the devouring dragon was not merely a symbol of day and night, of summer and winter; it was a literal explanation of the phenomena, it was the science of early times.
quote.author: Upton Sinclair
